Companion to gentells-site #229, which adds an "Observatory" link to the gentells.com nav for Intelligence and the team.

- The header now has "gentells.com ↗" on the right, next to the tools. Guests (Intelligence readers) see it as the only tool: Ask and the Studio stay the team's, as before.
- The address is `VITE_SITE_URL` when set, otherwise https://gentells.com.
- e2e: the guest menu test checks the link and that Studio and Ask are still absent. Full suite 49/49, build passes.
